summary: Solo female backpacker stranded by deep snow on the north side of Silver Creek Pass; cold and tired, unable to navigate the buried trail; helicopter extraction
location: Silver Creek Trail, East Avalanche Creek, Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness (Lead King Loop outside Marble)
responding_agency: Gunnison County Sheriff's Office; West Elk Mountain Rescue
notes: KVNF regional newscast 2023-07-12: WEMR responded to two incidents in three days on the Silver Creek Trail during the high-snowpack 2023 season; this party helicopter-transported.
